ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_advantage_normed_tanh_ratio
ir.intuition: Shift paradigm to pairwise_probability_ratio with a tanh-based normalized advantage gap acting as a smooth adaptive margin. Instead of raw difference or sigmoid link, use tanh to softly bound the margin effect and normalize log_prob difference by absolute advantage gap magnitude, ensuring stable gradients and adaptive scaling. Aggregate with weighted sum to diverge from prior mean aggregations and hinge-based families.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_norm = tanh(advantage_gap / (abs(advantage_gap) + epsilon))
score_diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (abs(advantage_gap) + epsilon)
x = score_diff - adv_norm
loss_per_pair = softplus(-x)
weighted_loss = weight * loss_per_pair
return sum(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    eps = 1e-6
    adv_abs = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    adv_safe = ops.add(adv_abs, eps)
    adv_norm = ops.tanh(ops.div(adv_gap, adv_safe))
    score_diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), adv_safe)
    x = ops.sub(score_diff, adv_norm)  # normalized difference minus bounded advantage
    loss_per_pair = ops.softplus(ops.neg(x))
    if weight is not None:
        loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss_per_pair)
